clue.text: Part holding the others up on stage?

definitions.text: Part holding the others up on stage?

parts.words: Part holding the others up on stage?
parts.note: read as an actor's part that physically props up the rest of the cast, rather than a minor part backing up the stars

explanation.surface: Someone wonders which stage role literally props up the rest of the cast.
explanation.walkthrough: The secondary part in a play backs up the lead actors; the clue pictures it as holding them up off the floor.
explanation.definitionFit: A secondary acting part that backs up the leads is the stage term for this.

clue.text: Is such a tray suspended in the office?

definitions.text: Is such a tray suspended in the office?

parts.words: Is such a tray suspended in the office?
parts.note: suspended suggests hanging from the ceiling, but here it means awaiting a decision, the office in-tray for undecided papers

explanation.surface: A puzzled worker asks whether a certain office tray hangs from the ceiling.
explanation.walkthrough: Suspended is the misleader: business that is suspended is waiting to be dealt with, and offices keep a tray named for such matters.
explanation.definitionFit: Awaiting a decision or still undecided, as papers in the office tray for later action are.

clue.text: Money some took to Bolivia

indicators.note: some of the following words supply the coin, its letters sitting inside them

explanation.surface: A traveller carries some cash on a trip to South America.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'to' and 'Bolivia'; 'took' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An ancient Greek silver coin, so a form of currency.

clue.text: Furnished with clothes fitted to requirements

definitions.meaning: supplied with garments, as a client dressed by a tailor
adapted or made to suit particular needs

explanation.surface: A customer is supplied with garments cut to order.
explanation.definitionFit: A tailor both dresses a client and cuts cloth to measure, giving both senses: clothed and custom-made.

clue.text: Official Tory, an eccentric

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so the letters of the words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Conservative office-holder is described as an oddball.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eccentric' seems to describe the Tory but tells you to rearrange TORY AN.
explanation.definitionFit: A legally authorised public official who witnesses and certifies documents.

clue.text: Re-posed

parts.note: read as having posed again, as a fashion model does, rather than as reshaped

explanation.walkthrough: Split it as RE-MODELLED: modelled once more, which is posing again; the usual sense is reshaped.
explanation.definitionFit: Reshaped or redesigned; read literally, it is having sat for an artist a second time.

clue.text: Draw being a matter of chance

definitions.meaning: a prize draw in which tickets are picked at random
something whose outcome depends purely on luck

explanation.surface: A raffle is described as entirely down to luck.
explanation.definitionFit: A prize draw with tickets is the literal sense; anything decided by luck is the figurative one.

clue.text: His mate will put an end to the game

definitions.text: His mate will put an end to the game

parts.words: His mate will put an end to the game
parts.note: mate seems to be a friend spoiling the fun, but it is checkmate, which finishes a board game

explanation.surface: A friend's arrival is going to spoil someone's sport.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mate' looks like a pal; here it is checkmate, delivered by one competitor at the board to end the contest.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor at the board who delivers checkmate, the move that ends play.

clue.text: Politician putting trade association first

parts.note: read as a politician who backs organised labour above all, while really naming a member of a political party that favours union of states

explanation.surface: A politician gives priority to a workers' organisation.
explanation.walkthrough: A trade association suggests a labour supporter; the term actually names a party favouring political union, as in Northern Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A supporter of keeping a political union intact, such as Northern Ireland within the UK, is called this.

clue.text: Trial marriage

definitions.meaning: a contest or test of strength between two sides
a wedding or pairing of two people

explanation.definitionFit: A contest or game between sides is one sense; a pairing of partners, as a good marriage is called, is the other.

clue.text: Fierce cat, it ruined the document

indicators.note: ruined means wrecked, so the letters of the preceding words are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A savage cat has torn up an important paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ruined' signals rearranging FIERCE CAT IT; 'the' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An official paper attesting a fact, such as a birth or qualification.

clue.text: It is no longer the thing to be way out

parts.note: a former partner or post-holder is called an ex, someone no longer in the role
the fashionable thing of the moment is said to be 'it'

explanation.surface: Something that has gone out of fashion is described as a way out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It is' and 'to be' are links; what was once 'it' and no longer is becomes EX + IT.
explanation.definitionFit: A door or passage leading outside is an egress.

clue.text: Special regulation costume worn by tennis players?

definitions.text: Special regulation costume worn by tennis players?

parts.words: Special regulation costume worn by tennis players?
parts.note: tennis players play on a court, so their kit would be named after it, though really this is formal attire required at a royal court

explanation.surface: Someone wonders what uniform is required of people playing tennis.
explanation.walkthrough: Formal dress required for presentation to a monarch shares its name with what might be worn on a tennis surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Formal attire prescribed for appearance at a royal court.

clue.text: Getting to one's feet but failing to keep one's appointment

definitions.meaning: jilting someone by not turning up for a date

explanation.surface: Someone rises from a chair yet still misses a date.
explanation.definitionFit: Rising from sitting is the literal sense; leaving a date waiting in vain is the idiom.

clue.text: Three got tipsy at the same time

indicators.note: tipsy means unsteady from drink, so the letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: Three people became drunk simultaneously.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tipsy' signals rearranging THREE GOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Simultaneously, all in one go, is a sense of this adverb.

clue.text: Fool about when young animal is about to produce an egg!

indicators.note: the young animal surrounds the egg-laying word, being about or around it

parts.note: a pup is a young dog or seal
a hen lays to produce an egg

explanation.surface: A frisky young creature misbehaves just as it is about to lay an egg.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when' is a link; the joke is that a pup would never lay an egg.
explanation.definitionFit: To misbehave or act the goat, as children playing up do.

clue.text: Side issues concern him

parts.note: side issues seems to mean minor matters, but it means questions of picking a team, which is this person's job

explanation.surface: Someone is preoccupied by minor matters.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'side issues' as team questions: the person who picks a sports side worries about them.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who chooses the players for a team is given this title.

clue.text: Not shrinking garment material

definitions.meaning: confronting something boldly rather than recoiling
fabric lining the edge of a garment, such as a lapel or cuff

explanation.surface: A fabric is guaranteed not to shrink in the wash.
explanation.definitionFit: Confronting rather than recoiling is one sense; the lining material at a jacket's cuffs and lapels is the other.

clue.text: Our gripping instrument first made a loud noise

indicators.note: the gripping tool's word comes first in the answer, ahead of the possessive word

parts.note: a clam is an old word for a clamp, a tool that grips

explanation.surface: Our clamping tool made a racket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' is a link before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An uproar or loud outcry from many voices.

clue.text: Made rare concoction using sugar

indicators.note: a concoction is a mixture, so the letters of the words before are mixed up

explanation.surface: Someone whipped up an unusual recipe with sugar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'using' is a link; 'concoction' signals rearranging MADE RARE.
explanation.definitionFit: A light brown cane sugar named after a region of Guyana.

clue.text: Sages mending first-class spear

indicators.note: mending means repairing or reworking, so the letters are put into a new order

parts.note: A1, written AI, means first-class

explanation.surface: Wise men repair an excellent spear.
explanation.walkthrough: SAGES rearranged gives ASSEG; A1 becomes AI in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: A slender iron-tipped spear used in southern Africa.

clue.text: A pupil, during disturbed rest, is not as fresh

indicators.note: the pupil's letter sits within the scrambled word, as if during it
disturbed means stirred up, so the letters of the word rest are rearranged

parts.note: L is a learner, as on a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A schoolchild's broken sleep leaves them tired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' turns REST into STER, and 'during' puts A and L inside it; 'is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of an adjective meaning stale, so less fresh or more tired.

clue.text: Carriage driver gives shout of encouragement to a trio performing inside

indicators.note: the following letters go within the shout of encouragement

parts.note: a cheer is a shout of encouragement

indicators.note: performing means acting up, so the letters of trio are shuffled

explanation.surface: A coachman shouts encouragement to a trio of musicians playing inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'performing' turns TRIO into RIOT; A plus that goes 'inside' CHEER.
explanation.definitionFit: A driver of a horse-drawn racing or war chariot.

clue.text: One's left with expedition leader in an isolated area

parts.note: one is I, so one's is I'S, giving IS

indicators.note: the leader of the word expedition is its first letter

explanation.surface: A lone person is abandoned with the head of an expedition in a remote place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' and 'in an' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A small island is a piece of land cut off by water.

clue.text: Brandy for Scotsman right to be included

indicators.note: the letter for right must be included within the word for the Scotsman

parts.note: Mac is a nickname for a Scotsman, from the Mac surnames

explanation.surface: A Scotsman orders a brandy and is right to do so.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A spirit distilled from grape skins and pulp left after pressing.

clue.text: Strip when ringleader leaves the crowd

indicators.note: the letter departs from the crowd word, leaving it shorter

parts.note: a throng is a crowd
the leader, or first letter, of the word ring is R

explanation.surface: A gang's boss abandons the mob.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ringleader' looks like a gang boss but is the first letter of 'ring'; 'when' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow strip of leather or other material, as a strap or lace.

clue.text: Apathetic state of learner with crooked grey hat

parts.note: L is a learner, as on learner plates

indicators.note: crooked means bent out of shape, so the letters of grey hat are rearranged

explanation.surface: A student in a lopsided grey hat looks listless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crooked' turns GREY HAT into ETHARGY, after L; 'of' and 'with' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of sluggishness and lack of energy or interest.

clue.text: Less than one legitimate part

parts.note: proper means correct or legitimate
a fraction is a part of a whole

explanation.surface: Something genuine is a portion of a whole.
explanation.walkthrough: In arithmetic, a value whose numerator is smaller than its denominator has this name.
explanation.definitionFit: A numerical expression whose numerator is smaller than its denominator, always below unity.
